newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel T&T unit buys site for S$9.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Keppel T&T unit buys site for S$9.8 mln.

text.p: Keppel Telecommunications & Transportation Ltd (Keppel T&T) said on Thursday its subsidiary bought a Singapore industrial site for Singapore $9.8 million.

Keppel Logistics Pte Ltd entered an agreement to buy the 12-acre (4.8 hectare) site in Jurong, in the western part of Singapore from Hydril Pte Ltd, to develop a second industrial park, a company statement said.
The second site would complement its existing facilities and marked Keppel Logistics' expansion into the integrated logistics business, Teo Soon Hoe, Keppel T&T chairman, said in the statement.
Keppel Logistics has also entered a joint venture with Malaysia International Shipping Corp Bhd in an 18-acre site in Jurong, it said.
